questions.textLatex: To run a motor its field winding is energized with a pulse train. The pulse is generated at a frequency and a duty cycle of $20\text{ Hz}$ and $80\%$, respectively, through PORTD.7. A pin PORTD.0 is used to scan the power line continuously.
